info.description: v2.4.1 runtime contract. Happy Path is Explicit Release Create → Validate HTTP 202 → Poll BuildJob to completed → Promote stable. Publish is Release-mode compatibility (HTTP 202, Application stays draft). Do not treat sync validate+promote or HTTP 200 on validate/publish as Happy Path.

request.description: HTTP 200 with checks.database/ragflow/backend all true is PASS. HTTP 503 is not PASS.

exec: const a = j.data && j.data.access_token, r = j.data && j.data.refresh_token;

if (r) { pm.collectionVariables.set('refresh_token', r); try { pm.environment.set('refresh_token', r); } catch(e) {} }
try { pm.environment.set('member_id', j.data.member_id); pm.environment.set('org_id', j.data.org_id); } catch(e) {}
if (value) { pm.collectionVariables.set('kb_id', value); try { pm.environment.set('kb_id', value); } catch(e) {} }

exec: const sf = j.data && j.data.source_file, fv = j.data && j.data.file_version_id, job = j.data && j.data.job;
if (sf && sf.id) { pm.collectionVariables.set('source_file_id', sf.id); try { pm.environment.set('source_file_id', sf.id); } catch(e) {} }
if (fv) { pm.collectionVariables.set('file_version_id', fv); try { pm.environment.set('file_version_id', fv); } catch(e) {} }
if (job && job.id) { pm.collectionVariables.set('ingestion_job_id', job.id); try { pm.environment.set('ingestion_job_id', job.id); } catch(e) {} }

if (pm.response.code===200) { const j=pm.response.json(); const jobs=(j.data&&j.data.jobs)||[]; if(jobs[0]) { pm.collectionVariables.set('build_job_id', jobs[0].id); try{pm.environment.set('build_job_id',jobs[0].id)}catch(e){} } }
if (value) { pm.collectionVariables.set('application_id', value); try { pm.environment.set('application_id', value); } catch(e) {} }

request.description: Happy Path is HTTP 202 with status=validating and validation_job_id. Poll BuildJob until completed before Promote. Not a sync validate+promote.
Poll until data.status is completed before Promote. Repeat this request while queued/running. If failed, inspect stage results. Do not Promote while validating.

exec: pm.test('validation job completed — retry this request before Promote if still queued/running', () => pm.expect(d.status).to.eql('completed'));

request.description: Release must be validated before Promote. Failed jobs are located via validation_error / job stages.
Run only after Poll Release Validation BuildJob is completed and Release status is validated.

exec: pm.test('same release_id as HTTP retrieval', () => pm.expect(d.release_id).to.eql(pm.environment.get('stable_release_id') || pm.environment.get('release_id')));
